text: 中国人民银行上海总部9月15日公布的数据显示，8月上海人民币贷款增加140亿元，同比多增93亿元；人民币存款增加314亿元，同比少增3609亿元。
text_en: Data released by the People's Bank of China Shanghai Head Office on September 15 showed that in August, Shanghai's RMB loans increased by 14 billion yuan, an increase of 9.3 billion yuan year-on-year; RMB deposits increased by 31.4 billion yuan, a decrease of 360.9 billion yuan year-on-year.
